text.KJV: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
text.ASV: and the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass-offering:
text.WEB: Then the priest shall put some of the oil that is in his hand on the tip of the right ear of him who is to be cleansed, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering.

text.KJV: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
text.ASV: and the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Jehovah.
text.WEB: The rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put on the head of him who is to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
text.ASV: And he shall offer one of the turtle-doves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to get,
text.WEB: He shall offer one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he is able to afford,

text.KJV: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
text.ASV: even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering, with the meal-offering: and the priest shall make atonement for him that is to be cleansed before Jehovah.
text.WEB: even such as he is able to afford, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meal offering. The priest shall make atonement for him who is to be cleansed before Yahweh.”

text.KJV: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
text.ASV: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to get `that which pertaineth' to his cleansing.
text.WEB: This is the law for him in whom is the plague of leprosy, who is not able to afford the sacrifice for his cleansing.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
text.ASV: When ye are come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
text.WEB: “When you have come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in the land of your possession,

text.KJV: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
text.ASV: then he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, There seemeth to me to be as it were a plague in the house.
text.WEB: then he who owns the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, ‘There seems to me to be some sort of plague in the house.’

text.KJV: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
text.ASV: And the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goeth in to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
text.WEB: The priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest goes in to examine the plague, that all that is in the house not be made unclean. Afterward the priest shall go in to inspect the house.

text.KJV: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
text.ASV: and he shall look on the plague; and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and the appearance thereof be lower than the wall;
text.WEB: He shall examine the plague; and behold, if the plague is in the walls of the house with hollow streaks, greenish or reddish, and it appears to be deeper than the wall;

text.KJV: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
text.ASV: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.
text.WEB: then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days.

text.KJV: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
text.ASV: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
text.WEB: The priest shall come again on the seventh day, and look. If the plague has spread in the walls of the house,

text.KJV: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
text.ASV: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which the plague is, and cast them into an unclean place without the city:
text.WEB: then the priest shall command that they take out the stones in which is the plague, and cast them into an unclean place outside of the city:

text.KJV: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
text.ASV: and he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scrape off, without the city into an unclean place:
text.WEB: and he shall cause the inside of the house to be scraped all over, and they shall pour out the mortar, that they scraped off, outside of the city into an unclean place.

text.KJV: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
text.ASV: and they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
text.WEB: They shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.

text.KJV: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;
text.ASV: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken out the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;
text.WEB: “If the plague comes again, and breaks out in the house, after he has taken out the stones, and after he has scraped the house, and after it was plastered;

text.KJV: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
text.ASV: then the priest shall come in and look; and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.
text.WEB: then the priest shall come in and look; and behold, if the plague has spread in the house, it is a destructive mildew in the house. It is unclean.

text.KJV: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
text.ASV: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
text.WEB: He shall break down the house, its stones, and its timber, and all the house’s mortar. He shall carry them out of the city into an unclean place.

text.KJV: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “Moreover he who goes into the house while it is shut up shall be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
text.ASV: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
text.WEB: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.

text.KJV: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
text.ASV: And if the priest shall come in, and look, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plastered; then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
text.WEB: “If the priest shall come in, and examine it, and behold, the plague hasn’t spread in the house, after the house was plastered, then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

text.KJV: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
text.ASV: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
text.WEB: To cleanse the house he shall take two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop.

text.KJV: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
text.ASV: and he shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
text.WEB: He shall kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

text.KJV: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
text.ASV: and he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
text.WEB: He shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

text.KJV: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
text.ASV: and he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
text.WEB: He shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, with the living bird, with the cedar wood, with the hyssop, and with the scarlet;

text.KJV: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
text.ASV: but he shall let got the living bird out of the city into the open field: so shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.
text.WEB: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

text.KJV: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
text.ASV: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and for a scall,
text.WEB: This is the law for any plague of leprosy, and for an itch,

text.KJV: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
text.ASV: and for the leprosy of a garment, and for a house,
text.WEB: and for the destructive mildew of a garment, and for a house,

text.KJV: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
text.ASV: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;
text.WEB: and for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

text.KJV: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
text.ASV: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
text.WEB: to teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean. This is the law of leprosy.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath an issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When any man has a discharge from his body, because of his discharge he is unclean.

text.KJV: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
text.ASV: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
text.WEB: This shall be his uncleanness in his discharge: whether his body runs with his discharge, or his body has stopped from his discharge, it is his uncleanness.

text.KJV: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
text.ASV: Every bed whereon he that hath the issue lieth shall be unclean; and everything whereon he sitteth shall be unclean.
text.WEB: “‘Every bed whereon he who has the discharge lies shall be unclean; and everything he sits on shall be unclean.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Whoever touches his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And he that sitteth on anything whereon he that hath the issue sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: He who sits on anything whereon the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “‘He who touches the body of him who has the discharge shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
text.ASV: And what saddle soever he that hath the issue rideth upon shall be unclean.
text.WEB: “‘Whatever saddle he who has the discharge rides on shall be unclean.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whosoever toucheth anything that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Whoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until the evening. He who carries those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whomsoever he that hath the issue toucheth, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “‘Whoever he who has the discharge touches, without having rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
text.ASV: And the earthen vessel, which he that hath the issue toucheth, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
text.WEB: “‘The earthen vessel, which he who has the discharge touches, shall be broken; and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

text.KJV: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
text.ASV: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue, then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
text.WEB: “‘When he who has a discharge is cleansed of his discharge, then he shall count to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes; and he shall bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

text.KJV: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
text.ASV: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and come before Jehovah unto the door of the tent of meeting, and give them unto the priest:
text.WEB: “‘On the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before Yahweh to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and give them to the priest:

text.KJV: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
text.ASV: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him before Jehovah for his issue.
text.WEB: and the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh for his discharge.

text.KJV: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “‘If any man has an emission of semen, then he shall bathe all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Every garment, and every skin, whereon the semen is, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: The woman also with whom a man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: If a man lies with a woman and there is an emission of semen, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And if a woman have an issue, `and' her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: “‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days: and whoever touches her shall be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
text.ASV: And everything that she lieth upon in her impurity shall be unclean: everything also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
text.WEB: “‘Everything that she lies on in her impurity shall be unclean. Everything also that she sits on shall be unclean.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whosoever toucheth anything that she sitteth upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Whoever touches anything that she sits on shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And if it be on the bed, or on anything whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: If it is on the bed, or on anything whereon she sits, when he touches it, he shall be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
text.ASV: And if any man lie with her, and her impurity be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
text.WEB: “‘If any man lies with her, and her monthly flow is on him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed whereon he lies shall be unclean.

text.KJV: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
text.ASV: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days not in the time of her impurity, or if she have an issue beyond the time of her impurity; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness she shall be as in the days of her impurity: she is unclean.
text.WEB: “‘If a woman has a discharge of her blood many days not in the time of her period, or if she has a discharge beyond the time of her period; all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be as in the days of her period: she is unclean.

text.KJV: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
text.ASV: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her impurity: and everything whereon she sitteth shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her impurity.
text.WEB: Every bed whereon she lies all the days of her discharge shall be to her as the bed of her period: and everything whereon she sits shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her period.

text.KJV: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.ASV: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
text.WEB: Whoever touches these things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

text.KJV: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
text.ASV: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
text.WEB: “‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

text.KJV: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtle-doves, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: On the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
text.ASV: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin-offering, and the other for a burnt-offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Jehovah for the issue of her uncleanness.
text.WEB: The priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her before Yahweh for the uncleanness of her discharge.

text.KJV: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
text.ASV: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is in the midst of them.
text.WEB: “‘Thus you shall separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness, so they will not die in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.’”

text.KJV: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
text.ASV: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed of copulation goeth from him, so that he is unclean thereby;
text.WEB: This is the law of him who has a discharge, and of him who has an emission of semen, so that he is unclean thereby;

text.KJV: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
text.ASV: and of her that is sick with her impurity, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
text.WEB: and of her who has her period, and of a man or woman who has a discharge, and of him who lies with her who is unclean.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before Jehovah, and died;
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they came near before Yahweh, and died;

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
text.ASV: and Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the mercy-seat which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy-seat.
text.WEB: and Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron your brother, not to come at all times into the Most Holy Place within the veil, before the mercy seat which is on the ark; lest he die: for I will appear in the cloud on the mercy seat.

text.KJV: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
text.ASV: Herewith shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin-offering, and a ram for a burnt-offering.
text.WEB: “Aaron shall come into the sanctuary with a young bull for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

text.KJV: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
text.ASV: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with the linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: they are the holy garments; and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and put them on.
text.WEB: He shall put on the holy linen coat. He shall have the linen breeches on his body, and shall put on the linen sash, and he shall be clothed with the linen turban. They are the holy garments. He shall bathe his body in water, and put them on.

text.KJV: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
text.ASV: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering, and one ram for a burnt-offering.
text.WEB: He shall take from the congregation of the children of Israel two male goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
text.ASV: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself, and for his house.
text.WEB: “Aaron shall offer the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make atonement for himself and for his house.

text.KJV: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
text.ASV: And he shall take the two goats, and set them before Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting.
text.WEB: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
text.ASV: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Jehovah, and the other lot for Azazel.
text.WEB: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats; one lot for Yahweh, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
text.ASV: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer him for a sin-offering.
text.WEB: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.

text.KJV: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
text.ASV: But the goat, on which the lot fell for Azazel, shall be set alive before Jehovah, to make atonement for him, to send him away for Azazel into the wilderness.
text.WEB: But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him, to send him away as the scapegoat into the wilderness.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
text.ASV: And Aaron shall present the bullock of the sin-offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin-offering which is for himself:
text.WEB: “Aaron shall present the bull of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make atonement for himself and for his house, and shall kill the bull of the sin offering which is for himself.

text.KJV: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
text.ASV: and he shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Jehovah, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:
text.WEB: He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the veil:

text.KJV: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
text.ASV: and he shall put the incense upon the fire before Jehovah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy-seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
text.WEB: and he shall put the incense on the fire before Yahweh, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is on the testimony, so that he will not die.

text.KJV: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
text.ASV: and he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy-seat on the east; and before the mercy-seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
text.WEB: He shall take some of the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it with his finger on the mercy seat on the east; and before the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.

text.KJV: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
text.ASV: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin-offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy-seat, and before the mercy-seat:
text.WEB: “Then he shall kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with his blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat.

text.KJV: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
text.ASV: and he shall make atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins: and so shall he do for the tent of meeting, that dwelleth with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.
text.WEB: He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions, even all their sins; and so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting, that dwells with them in the middle of their uncleanness.

text.KJV: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
text.ASV: And there shall be no man in the tent of meeting when he goeth in to make atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.
text.WEB: No one shall be in the Tent of Meeting when he enters to make atonement in the Holy Place, until he comes out, and has made atonement for himself and for his household, and for all the assembly of Israel.

text.KJV: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
text.ASV: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Jehovah, and make atonement for it, and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
text.WEB: “He shall go out to the altar that is before Yahweh and make atonement for it, and shall take some of the bull’s blood, and some of the goat’s blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar.

text.KJV: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleannesses of the children of Israel.
text.WEB: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and make it holy from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
text.ASV: And when he hath made an end of atoning for the holy place, and the tent of meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat:
text.WEB: “When he has finished atoning for the Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
text.ASV: and Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a man that is in readiness into the wilderness:
text.WEB: Aaron shall lay both his hands on the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions, even all their sins; and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.

text.KJV: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
text.ASV: and the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a solitary land: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
text.WEB: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

text.KJV: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
text.ASV: And Aaron shall come into the tent of meeting, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
text.WEB: “Aaron shall come into the Tent of Meeting, and shall take off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the Holy Place, and shall leave them there.

text.KJV: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
text.ASV: and he shall bathe his flesh in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt-offering and the burnt-offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.
text.WEB: Then he shall bathe himself in water in a holy place, and put on his garments, and come out and offer his burnt offering and the burnt offering of the people, and make atonement for himself and for the people.

text.KJV: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
text.ASV: And the fat of the sin-offering shall he burn upon the altar.
text.WEB: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

text.KJV: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
text.ASV: And he that letteth go the goat for Azazel shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
text.WEB: “He who lets the goat go as the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

text.KJV: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
text.ASV: And the bullock of the sin-offering, and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
text.WEB: The bull for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be carried outside the camp; and they shall burn their skins, their flesh, and their dung with fire.

text.KJV: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
text.ASV: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
text.WEB: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

text.KJV: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
text.ASV: And it shall be a statute for ever unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and shall do no manner of work, the home-born, or the stranger that sojourneth among you:
text.WEB: “It shall be a statute to you forever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and shall do no kind of work, the native-born, or the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you:

text.KJV: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
text.ASV: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins shall ye be clean before Jehovah.
text.WEB: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins you shall be clean before Yahweh.

text.KJV: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
text.ASV: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
text.WEB: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.

text.KJV: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
text.ASV: And the priest, who shall be anointed and who shall be consecrated to be priest in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments:
text.WEB: The priest, who is anointed and who is consecrated to be priest in his father’s place, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.

text.KJV: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
text.ASV: and he shall make atonement for the holy sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the tent of meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.
text.WEB: Then he shall make atonement for the Holy Sanctuary; and he shall make atonement for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar; and he shall make atonement for the priests and for all the people of the assembly.

text.KJV: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the children of Israel because of all their sins once in the year. And he did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: “This shall be an everlasting statute for you, to make atonement for the children of Israel once in the year because of all their sins.” It was done as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,
text.WEB: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them: ‘This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded,

text.KJV: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
text.ASV: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,
text.WEB: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel, who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

text.KJV: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
text.ASV: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
text.WEB: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people.

text.KJV: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
text.ASV: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on Yahweh’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
text.ASV: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute forever unto them throughout their generations.
text.WEB: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’

text.KJV: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
text.ASV: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,
text.WEB: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

text.KJV: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
text.ASV: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.
text.WEB: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to sacrifice it to Yahweh; that man shall be cut off from his people.

text.KJV: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
text.ASV: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
text.WEB: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

text.KJV: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
text.ASV: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.
text.WEB: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.

text.KJV: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
text.ASV: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
text.WEB: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”

text.KJV: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
text.ASV: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
text.WEB: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.

text.KJV: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
text.ASV: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is `all one' with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
text.WEB: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life: therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”

text.KJV: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
text.ASV: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
text.WEB: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening: then he shall be clean.

text.KJV: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
text.ASV: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.
text.WEB: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
text.ASV: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.
text.WEB: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived: and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

text.KJV: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: You shall do my ordinances, and you shall keep my statutes, and walk in them: I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances; which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover `their' nakedness: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.ASV: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

text.KJV: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
text.ASV: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.

text.KJV: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
text.ASV: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home, or born abroad.

text.KJV: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
text.ASV: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness: for theirs is your own nakedness.

text.KJV: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.ASV: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law: she is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

text.KJV: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival `to her', to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.

text.KJV: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

text.KJV: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor's wife, to defile thyself with her.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor's wife, to defile thyself with her.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.

text.KJV: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through `the fire' to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not lie with a man, as with a woman. That is detestable.

text.KJV: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.

text.KJV: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
text.ASV: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;
text.WEB: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.

text.KJV: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
text.ASV: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.
text.WEB: The land was defiled: therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.

text.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
text.ASV: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you;
text.WEB: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you;

text.KJV: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
text.ASV: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);
text.WEB: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled);

text.KJV: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
text.ASV: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
text.WEB: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

text.KJV: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
text.ASV: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
text.WEB: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

text.KJV: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs, which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am Yahweh your God.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.
text.ASV: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.
text.WEB: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, Yahweh your God, am holy.

text.KJV: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
text.ASV: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.
text.WEB: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.

text.KJV: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
text.ASV: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.
text.WEB: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day: and if anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.

text.KJV: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
text.ASV: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:
text.WEB: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;

text.KJV: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
text.ASV: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
text.WEB: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

text.KJV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
text.ASV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.
text.WEB: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

text.KJV: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
text.ASV: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not steal. “‘You shall not lie. “‘You shall not deceive one another.

text.KJV: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbor, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him. “‘The wages of a hired servant shall not remain with you all night until the morning.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling-block before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.
text.ASV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.
text.WEB: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor; I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not go up and down as a slanderer among your people. “‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbor, and not suffer sin upon him.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woolen come upon thee.
text.ASV: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.
text.WEB: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

text.KJV: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
text.ASV: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
text.WEB: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed, or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

text.KJV: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
text.ASV: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.
text.WEB: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.

text.KJV: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
text.ASV: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.
text.WEB: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahweh for his sin which he has committed: and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.

text.KJV: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
text.ASV: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.
text.WEB: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. Three years they shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.

text.KJV: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal.
text.ASV: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
text.ASV: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.

text.KJV: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
text.ASV: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.

text.KJV: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
text.ASV: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
text.WEB: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.

text.KJV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Jehovah.
