text.WEB: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head, and honor the face of an old man, and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
text.ASV: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.
text.WEB: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.

text.KJV: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
text.ASV: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
text.WEB: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

text.KJV: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
text.ASV: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
text.WEB: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

text.KJV: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall observe all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
text.ASV: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
text.WEB: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech; he shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone him with stones.

text.KJV: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
text.ASV: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
text.WEB: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

text.KJV: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
text.ASV: And if the people at the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;
text.WEB: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person, when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death;

text.KJV: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
text.ASV: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.
text.WEB: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him, to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.

text.KJV: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
text.ASV: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
text.WEB: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums, and to the wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.

text.KJV: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.
text.ASV: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.
text.WEB: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am Yahweh who sanctifies you.

text.KJV: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
text.ASV: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
text.WEB: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

text.KJV: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.ASV: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.WEB: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

text.KJV: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
text.ASV: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
text.WEB: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have committed a perversion; their blood shall be upon them.

text.KJV: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.ASV: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.WEB: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

text.KJV: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
text.ASV: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
text.WEB: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burned with fire, both he and they; that there may be no wickedness among you.

text.KJV: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
text.ASV: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
text.WEB: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.

text.KJV: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.ASV: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
text.WEB: “‘If a woman approaches any animal, and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.

text.KJV: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
text.ASV: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
text.WEB: “‘If a man takes his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.

text.KJV: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
text.ASV: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
text.WEB: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness; he has made naked her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

text.KJV: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
text.ASV: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister, nor of thy father's sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
text.WEB: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister; for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.

text.KJV: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
text.ASV: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
text.WEB: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.

text.KJV: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
text.ASV: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
text.WEB: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.

text.KJV: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
text.ASV: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.
text.WEB: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them; that the land, where I am bringing you to dwell, may not vomit you out.

text.KJV: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
text.ASV: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
text.WEB: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I am casting out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

text.KJV: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.
text.ASV: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.
text.WEB: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

text.KJV: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
text.ASV: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.
text.WEB: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and you shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

text.KJV: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.
text.ASV: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.
text.WEB: You shall be holy to me; for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

text.KJV: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
text.ASV: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.
text.WEB: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium, or is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones. Their blood shall be upon them.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
text.ASV: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people;

text.KJV: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother.
text.ASV: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
text.WEB: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

text.KJV: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
text.ASV: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.
text.WEB: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

text.KJV: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
text.ASV: He shall not defile himself, `being' a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
text.WEB: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

text.KJV: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
text.ASV: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
text.WEB: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

text.KJV: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
text.ASV: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
text.WEB: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.

text.KJV: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
text.ASV: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.
text.WEB: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. They shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

text.KJV: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, am holy.
text.ASV: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.
text.WEB: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you; for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

text.KJV: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
text.ASV: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
text.WEB: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

text.KJV: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
text.ASV: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;
text.WEB: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

text.KJV: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
text.ASV: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
text.WEB: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father, or for his mother.

text.KJV: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
text.ASV: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
text.WEB: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

text.KJV: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
text.ASV: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.
text.WEB: A widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry: but a virgin of his own people shall he take as a wife.

text.KJV: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
text.ASV: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.
text.WEB: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.
text.WEB: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

text.KJV: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
text.ASV: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,
text.WEB: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

text.KJV: Or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
text.ASV: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,
text.WEB: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

text.KJV: Or crookbacked, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
text.ASV: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
text.WEB: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

text.KJV: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
text.ASV: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
text.WEB: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

text.KJV: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
text.ASV: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:
text.WEB: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

text.KJV: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
text.ASV: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
text.WEB: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

text.KJV: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
text.ASV: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
text.WEB: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
text.ASV: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
text.WEB: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose offspring goes from him;

text.KJV: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
text.ASV: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
text.WEB: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;

text.KJV: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
text.ASV: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.
text.WEB: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathes his body in water.

text.KJV: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
text.ASV: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
text.WEB: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

text.KJV: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith; I am the LORD.
text.ASV: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
text.ASV: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
text.WEB: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

text.KJV: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
text.ASV: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest's, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
text.WEB: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

text.KJV: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
text.ASV: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
text.WEB: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

text.KJV: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
text.ASV: And if a priest's daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.
text.WEB: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

text.KJV: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall be no stranger eat thereof.
text.ASV: But if a priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
text.WEB: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.

text.KJV: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
text.ASV: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.
text.WEB: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

text.KJV: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
text.ASV: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,
text.WEB: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

text.KJV: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
text.ASV: and `so' cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.
text.WEB: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
text.ASV: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;
text.WEB: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;

text.KJV: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
text.ASV: that ye may be accepted, `ye shall offer' a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.
text.WEB: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

text.KJV: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
text.ASV: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
text.WEB: But whatever has a defect, that you shall not offer; for it shall not be acceptable for you.

text.KJV: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
text.ASV: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
text.WEB: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

text.KJV: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore: you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
text.ASV: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
text.WEB: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

text.KJV: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.
text.ASV: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do `thus' in your land.
text.WEB: You must not offer to Yahweh that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

text.KJV: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
text.ASV: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
text.WEB: You must not offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner as any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And whether it be cow, or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
text.ASV: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
text.WEB: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

text.KJV: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer it at your own will.
text.ASV: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.
text.WEB: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

text.KJV: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,
text.ASV: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,
text.WEB: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

text.KJV: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

text.KJV: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
text.ASV: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.
text.WEB: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

text.KJV: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
text.ASV: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.
text.WEB: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

text.KJV: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD's passover.
text.ASV: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah's passover.
text.WEB: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

text.KJV: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
text.ASV: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.
text.WEB: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

text.KJV: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
text.ASV: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.
text.WEB: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

text.KJV: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
text.ASV: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
text.WEB: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest:

text.KJV: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
text.ASV: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
text.WEB: and he shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

text.KJV: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savor: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
text.ASV: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts `of an ephah' of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
text.WEB: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

text.KJV: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.ASV: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.WEB: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

text.KJV: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
text.ASV: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:
text.WEB: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven Sabbaths shall be completed:

text.KJV: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
text.ASV: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: even to the next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals; they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baked with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts `of an ephah': they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savor unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
text.ASV: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.
text.WEB: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

text.KJV: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
text.ASV: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.
text.WEB: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

text.KJV: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
text.ASV: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
text.WEB: You shall make proclamation on the same day: there shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

text.KJV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field, and you must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor, and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest to you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

text.KJV: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall do no regular work; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation to you, and you shall afflict yourselves; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
text.ASV: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: You shall do no kind of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
text.ASV: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day; he shall be cut off from his people.
text.WEB: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day; shall be cut off from his people.

text.KJV: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
text.ASV: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.
text.WEB: Whoever it is who does any kind of work in that same day, that person I will destroy from among his people.

text.KJV: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.ASV: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
text.WEB: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

text.KJV: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
text.ASV: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.
text.WEB: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tents for seven days to Yahweh.

text.KJV: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
text.ASV: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.
text.WEB: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.

text.KJV: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein.
text.ASV: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work.
text.WEB: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

text.KJV: These are the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
text.ASV: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;
text.WEB: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, and a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

text.KJV: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
text.ASV: besides the sabbaths o Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: besides the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
text.ASV: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
text.WEB: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

text.KJV: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
text.ASV: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.
text.WEB: You shall take on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

text.KJV: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
text.ASV: And ye shall keep it a feast unto Jehovah seven days in the year: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.
text.WEB: You shall keep it as a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

text.KJV: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
text.ASV: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
text.WEB: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

text.KJV: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

text.KJV: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
text.ASV: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.
text.WEB: Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
text.ASV: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
text.WEB: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

text.KJV: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
text.ASV: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.
text.WEB: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

text.KJV: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.
text.ASV: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.
text.WEB: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.

text.KJV: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
text.ASV: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts `of an ephah' shall be in one cake.
text.WEB: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

text.KJV: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
text.ASV: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.

text.KJV: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
text.ASV: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.
text.WEB: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

text.KJV: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
text.ASV: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.
text.WEB: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

text.KJV: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
text.ASV: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:
text.WEB: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

text.KJV: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
text.ASV: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
text.WEB: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

text.KJV: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be showed them.
text.ASV: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.
text.WEB: They put him in custody, until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
text.ASV: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
text.WEB: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

text.KJV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
text.ASV: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
text.WEB: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

text.KJV: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the Lord, shall be put to death.
text.ASV: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name `of Jehovah', shall be put to death.
text.WEB: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

text.KJV: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
text.ASV: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.
text.WEB: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

text.KJV: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
text.ASV: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:
text.WEB: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

text.KJV: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
text.ASV: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.
text.WEB: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.

text.KJV: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
text.ASV: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.
text.WEB: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

text.KJV: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”

text.KJV: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
text.ASV: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
text.WEB: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.

text.KJV: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
text.ASV: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;
text.WEB: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

text.KJV: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
text.ASV: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
text.WEB: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

text.KJV: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
text.ASV: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather: it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
text.WEB: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

text.KJV: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee.
text.ASV: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.
text.WEB: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

text.KJV: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
text.ASV: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.
text.WEB: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

text.KJV: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
text.ASV: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.
text.WEB: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

text.KJV: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
text.ASV: Then shalt thou send abroad the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye send abroad the trumpet throughout all your land.
text.WEB: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

text.KJV: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
text.ASV: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
text.WEB: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

text.KJV: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
text.ASV: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather `the grapes' in it of the undressed vines.
text.WEB: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

text.KJV: For it is the jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
text.ASV: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
text.WEB: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

text.KJV: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.
text.ASV: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.
text.WEB: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

text.KJV: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbor, or buyest ought of thy neighbor's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
text.ASV: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbor, or buy of thy neighbor's hand, ye shall not wrong one another.
text.WEB: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

text.KJV: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
text.ASV: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, `and' according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.
text.WEB: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

text.KJV: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
text.ASV: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of the crops doth he sell unto thee.
text.WEB: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

text.KJV: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: You shall not wrong one another; but you shall fear your God: for I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
text.ASV: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
text.WEB: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

text.KJV: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
text.ASV: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
text.WEB: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

text.KJV: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
text.ASV: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;
text.WEB: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase”;

text.KJV: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
text.ASV: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.
text.WEB: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

text.KJV: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store.
text.ASV: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, ye shall eat the old store.
text.WEB: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

text.KJV: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine, for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
