text.ASV: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity; for the land is mine: for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.
text.WEB: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

text.KJV: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
text.ASV: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
text.WEB: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

text.KJV: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
text.ASV: If thy brother be waxed poor, and sell some of his possession, then shall his kinsman that is next unto him come, and shall redeem that which his brother hath sold.
text.WEB: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

text.KJV: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
text.ASV: And if a man have no one to redeem it, and he be waxed rich and find sufficient to redeem it;
text.WEB: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it;

text.KJV: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
text.ASV: then let him reckon the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return unto his possession.
text.WEB: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

text.KJV: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
text.ASV: But if he be not able to get it back for himself, then that which he hath sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee: and in the jubilee it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
text.WEB: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee: and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

text.KJV: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
text.ASV: And if a man sell a dwelling-house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; for a full year shall he have the right of redemption.
text.WEB: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

text.KJV: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.
text.ASV: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him that bought it, throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubilee.
text.WEB: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

text.KJV: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
text.ASV: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubilee.
text.WEB: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

text.KJV: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
text.ASV: Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
text.WEB: “‘Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.

text.KJV: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubilee: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
text.ASV: And if one of the Levites redeem, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.
text.WEB: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

text.KJV: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
text.ASV: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
text.WEB: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

text.KJV: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
text.ASV: And if thy brother be waxed poor, and his hand fail with thee; then thou shalt uphold him: `as' a stranger and a sojourner shall he live with thee.
text.WEB: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

text.KJV: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
text.ASV: Take thou no interest of him or increase, but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
text.WEB: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God; that your brother may live among you.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon interest, nor give him thy victuals for increase.
text.WEB: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

text.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
text.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, `and' to be your God.
text.WEB: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

text.KJV: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
text.ASV: And if thy brother be waxed poor with thee, and sell himself unto thee; thou shalt not make him to serve as a bond-servant.
text.WEB: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you; you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

text.KJV: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee.
text.ASV: As a hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee; he shall serve with thee unto the year of jubilee:
text.WEB: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee:

text.KJV: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
text.ASV: then shall he go out from thee, he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
text.WEB: then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

text.KJV: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
text.ASV: For they are my servants, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
text.WEB: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

text.KJV: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigor; but shalt fear thy God.
text.ASV: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigor, but shalt fear thy God.
text.WEB: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

text.KJV: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
text.ASV: And as for thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, whom thou shalt have; of the nations that are round about you, of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
text.WEB: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

text.KJV: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
text.ASV: Moreover of the children of the strangers that sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they have begotten in your land: and they shall be your possession.
text.WEB: Moreover of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

text.KJV: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigor.
text.ASV: And ye shall make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them shall ye take your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel ye shall not rule, one over another, with rigor.
text.WEB: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them may you take your slaves forever; but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

text.KJV: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
text.ASV: And if a stranger or sojourner with thee be waxed rich, and thy brother be waxed poor beside him, and sell himself unto the stranger `or' sojourner with thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family;
text.WEB: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family;

text.KJV: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
text.ASV: after that he is sold he may be redeemed: one of his brethren may redeem him;
text.WEB: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

text.KJV: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
text.ASV: or his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be waxed rich, he may redeem himself.
text.WEB: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

text.KJV: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
text.ASV: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he sold himself to him unto the year of jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.
text.WEB: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

text.KJV: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
text.ASV: If there be yet many years, according unto them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
text.WEB: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

text.KJV: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
text.ASV: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according unto his years shall he give back the price of his redemption.
text.WEB: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

text.KJV: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.
text.ASV: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.
text.WEB: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

text.KJV: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, both he, and his children with him.
text.ASV: And if he be not redeemed by these `means', then he shall go out in the year of jubilee, he, and his children with him.
text.WEB: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee, he, and his children with him.

text.KJV: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
text.ASV: Ye shall make you no idols, neither shall ye rear you up a graven image, or a pillar, neither shall ye place any figured stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Jehovah your God.
text.WEB: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am Yahweh your God.

text.KJV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

text.KJV: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
text.ASV: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
text.WEB: “‘If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

text.KJV: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
text.ASV: then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
text.WEB: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

text.KJV: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
text.ASV: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time; and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
text.WEB: Your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

text.KJV: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
text.ASV: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
text.WEB: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

text.KJV: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
text.ASV: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
text.WEB: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

text.KJV: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
text.ASV: And five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
text.WEB: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

text.KJV: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
text.ASV: And I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.
text.WEB: “‘I will have respect for you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

text.KJV: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
text.ASV: And ye shall eat old store long kept, and ye shall bring forth the old because of the new.
text.WEB: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

text.KJV: And I set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
text.ASV: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
text.WEB: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

text.KJV: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
text.ASV: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
text.WEB: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

text.KJV: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
text.ASV: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.
text.WEB: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.

text.KJV: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
text.ASV: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
text.WEB: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;

text.KJV: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:
text.ASV: and if ye shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhor mine ordinances, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;
text.WEB: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;

text.KJV: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
text.ASV: I also will do this unto you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
text.WEB: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

text.KJV: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
text.ASV: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be smitten before your enemies: they that hate you shall rule over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
text.WEB: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

text.KJV: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
text.ASV: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
text.WEB: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

text.KJV: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
text.ASV: And I will break the pride of your power: and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass;
text.WEB: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like brass.

text.KJV: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
text.ASV: and your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
text.WEB: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

text.KJV: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
text.ASV: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me, I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
text.WEB: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

text.KJV: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
text.ASV: And I will send the beast of the field among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your ways shall become desolate.
text.WEB: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

text.KJV: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
text.ASV: And if by these things ye will not be reformed unto me, but will walk contrary unto me;
text.WEB: “‘If by these things you won’t be reformed to me, but will walk contrary to me;

text.KJV: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
text.ASV: then will I also walk contrary unto you; and I will smite you, even I, seven times for your sins.
text.WEB: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

text.KJV: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
text.ASV: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall execute the vengeance of the covenant; and ye shall be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
text.WEB: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

text.KJV: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
text.ASV: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
text.WEB: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

text.KJV: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
text.ASV: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
text.WEB: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me;

text.KJV: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
text.ASV: then I will walk contrary unto you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.
text.WEB: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

text.KJV: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
text.ASV: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
text.WEB: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

text.KJV: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
text.ASV: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your sun-images, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul shall abhor you.
text.WEB: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

text.KJV: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.
text.ASV: And I will make your cities a waste, and will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savor of your sweet odors.
text.WEB: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

text.KJV: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
text.ASV: And I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
text.WEB: I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein will be astonished at it.

text.KJV: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
text.ASV: And you will I scatter among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land shall be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.
text.WEB: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

text.KJV: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
text.ASV: Then shall the land enjoy its sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye are in your enemies' land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy its sabbaths.
text.WEB: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

text.KJV: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
text.ASV: As long as it lieth desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it had not in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
text.WEB: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths, when you lived on it.

text.KJV: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
text.ASV: And as for them that are left of you, I will send a faintness into their heart in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as one fleeth from the sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
text.WEB: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

text.KJV: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
text.ASV: And they shall stumble one upon another, as it were before the sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
text.WEB: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

text.KJV: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
text.ASV: And ye shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
text.WEB: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

text.KJV: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
text.ASV: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
text.WEB: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

text.KJV: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
text.ASV: And they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary unto me,
text.WEB: “‘If they confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary to me,

text.KJV: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
text.ASV: I also walked contrary unto them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity;
text.WEB: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity;

text.KJV: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
text.ASV: then will I remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
text.WEB: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

text.KJV: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
text.ASV: The land also shall be left by them, and shall enjoy its sabbaths, while it lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected mine ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.
text.WEB: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them: and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

text.KJV: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.
text.ASV: And yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Jehovah their God;
text.WEB: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God;

text.KJV: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD.
text.ASV: but I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God: I am Jehovah.
text.WEB: but I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”

text.KJV: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
text.ASV: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by Moses.
text.WEB: These are the statutes, ordinances and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

text.KJV: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
text.ASV: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,
text.WEB: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

text.KJV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.
text.ASV: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall accomplish a vow, the persons shall be for Jehovah by thy estimation.
text.WEB: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to Yahweh in a vow, according to your valuation,

text.KJV: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
text.ASV: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
text.WEB: your valuation of a male from twenty years old even to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

text.KJV: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
text.ASV: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
text.WEB: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

text.KJV: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
text.ASV: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
text.WEB: If the person is from five years old even to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

text.KJV: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
text.ASV: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
text.WEB: If the person is from a month old even to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

text.KJV: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
text.ASV: And if it be from sixty years old and upward; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
text.WEB: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

text.KJV: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
text.ASV: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him that vowed shall the priest value him.
text.WEB: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

text.KJV: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
text.ASV: And if it be a beast, whereof men offer an oblation unto Jehovah, all that any man giveth of such unto Jehovah shall be holy.
text.WEB: “‘If it is an animal, of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

text.KJV: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
text.ASV: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.
text.WEB: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.

text.KJV: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
text.ASV: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer an oblation unto Jehovah, then he shall set the beast before the priest;
text.WEB: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

text.KJV: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.
text.ASV: and the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou the priest valuest it, so shall it be.
text.WEB: and the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest values it, so shall it be.

text.KJV: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
text.ASV: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.
text.WEB: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

text.KJV: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
text.ASV: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Jehovah, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
text.WEB: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall evaluate it, so shall it stand.

text.KJV: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
text.ASV: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
text.WEB: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

text.KJV: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
text.ASV: And if a man shall sanctify unto Jehovah part of the field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the sowing thereof: the sowing of a homer of barley `shall be valued' at fifty shekels of silver.
text.WEB: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

text.KJV: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
text.ASV: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubilee, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
text.WEB: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

text.KJV: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubilee, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
text.ASV: But if he sanctify his field after the jubilee, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain unto the year of jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from thy estimation.
text.WEB: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

text.KJV: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
text.ASV: And if he that sanctified the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
text.WEB: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

text.KJV: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
text.ASV: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more:
text.WEB: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

text.KJV: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
text.ASV: but the field, when it goeth out in the jubilee, shall be holy unto Jehovah, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
text.WEB: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

text.KJV: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;
text.ASV: And if he sanctify unto Jehovah a field which he hath bought, which is not of the field of his possession;
text.WEB: “‘If he dedicates a field to Yahweh which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

text.KJV: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD.
text.ASV: then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation unto the year of jubilee: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

text.KJV: In the year of the jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong.
text.ASV: In the year of jubilee the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongeth.
text.WEB: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

text.KJV: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
text.ASV: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
text.WEB: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

text.KJV: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD's.
text.ASV: Only the firstling among beasts, which is made a firstling to Jehovah, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox or sheep, it is Jehovah's.
text.WEB: “‘Only the firstborn among animals, which is made Yahweh’s firstborn, no man may dedicate; whether an ox or a sheep. It is Yahweh’s.

text.KJV: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
text.ASV: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall ransom it according to thine estimation, and shall add unto it the fifth part thereof: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
text.WEB: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

text.KJV: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.
text.ASV: Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto Jehovah of all that he hath, whether of man or beast, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything devoted to destruction is most holy to Yahweh.

text.KJV: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.
text.ASV: No one devoted, that shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.
text.WEB: “‘No one devoted, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.

text.KJV: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD's: it is holy unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is Jehovah's: it is holy unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

text.KJV: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.
text.ASV: And if a man will redeem aught of his tithe, he shall add unto it the fifth part thereof.
text.WEB: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

text.KJV: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
text.ASV: And all the tithe of the herd or the flock, whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto Jehovah.
text.WEB: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

text.KJV: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
text.ASV: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
text.WEB: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it. If he changes it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

text.KJV: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
text.ASV: These are the commandments, which Jehovah commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
text.WEB: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
